Over The Cap. Contract history row: Extension, signed 2025, 1 yr, total $25,000,000, APY $25,000,000, guarantees $25,000,000 (OTC total on that row, unsplit, so guarantee columns left blank). OTC contract notes also say the one-year extension plus two remaining years on the prior deal is $65,000,000, with $40,000,000 now guaranteed of which $25,000,000 is fully guaranteed at signing; those larger totals are not stored as total_value. 2026 cap hit $20,299,000 is on the OTC PHI active roster: base $1,300,000 + signing proration $9,910,000 + option proration $9,089,000. cap_active_while_roster_retired is set on 2026 only, so membership other/RET still counts this hit as an active charge and does not turn it into dead money. Johnson announced his retirement in October 2026; OTC still lists the 2026 hit as active, and the Eagles are keeping him on the roster for cap purposes until about June 2, 2027 (Over The Cap retirement analysis; NBC Sports / ProFootballTalk). This flag does not change roster membership or the depth chart. 2027 is the OTC contract line whose components add to $21,090,000 and is not a processed dead-money figure. Void years omitted. Years left blank because the imported seasons are partial. No option-bonus repayment is applied: OTC's published 2026 cap number is still $20,299,000. OTC and NBC describe a $21,700,000 2026 option whose unpaid portion and repayment amount are not final.

adjustments.note: Net of Over The Cap PHI 2026 lines not attached to a DB roster contract (fetched 2026-11-05): +$14,896,635 cap room above the $301,200,000 league cap (OTC Total Cap Liabilities $306,924,060 + Team Cap Space $9,172,575 = $316,096,635; carryover/other split not published on the page, so kept as one number), -$82,776,143 dead money (OTC dead-money table total), -$4,176,251 practice squad (OTC PS table total), -$1,145,000 Jakorian Bennett (OTC Reserve/IR cap hit; no contract row in this file, so the hit is carried here once. Registry roster_status is RES — do not also add a contract or this hit would be counted twice). Lane Johnson $20,299,000 is a roster contract with cap_active_while_roster_retired on 2026, not part of this adjustment. With him counted, PHI in-season space is $9,172,575, matching OTC.
